summary: Final five images and the same-scene neutral comparison demonstrate a modest but genuine continuous white courtyard-wall/pier distinction and a small gray canopy-edge accent. PASS only for 1395 complete white faces and 9 complete gray fascia faces. Large roof, exterior rear, ends and all window backs remain neutral; this is not whole-building color reconstruction.

per_view.front: 完整模型及底座入鏡。凹弧庭院白色不透明牆與立柱形成較清楚的連續面，與仍中性的窗凹背區分；入口灰雨棚前立邊可辨。未為擴大收益染屋頂、外弧背面或側端。
per_view.opposite: 相反斜視再次見白面僅在來源可支持的內弧牆／柱；端牆、屋頂、外弧及窗背未鏡射擴色。細白框沒有幾何邊界，仍保持中性。
per_view.elevation: 白牆／柱與中性窗背的區分最易閱讀，灰雨棚垂直邊形成小幅入口對比。未把玻璃、門扇或整個入口凹區塗成深色。
per_view.rear: 大部分外背弧、後突出部、屋面和底座維持中性；只有遠側可見的受證庭院面局部有色，不聲稱背面改善。
per_view.top: 水平大屋頂、屋簷頂面與雨棚頂面均中性；頂視收益接近無。側／頂色界為有限證據域而非新增實際材料接縫。

visual_review.same_angle_benefit: The final neutral comparison uses the same actual scene, cameras, lights, geometry and rendering settings. Only temporary polygon material indices change, and the original scene is not resaved. The white courtyard planes and gray fascia are visibly more distinct than the mono image. No camera change, roof repainting or invented dark glazing is needed to create the observed localized benefit.
source_alignment: The full official front photograph shows white/light tiled inner curved wall and piers across four levels; central/right areas are clear, the left foreground is partly tree-occluded.
The official close oblique supports white pier sides and wall surfaces and gray canopy edges. Dark streaks, dirt and shade are not separate geometric material bands.
The real canopy is curved and detailed; the original model is a rectangular simplification. This unchanged simplified shape is disclosed and is not repaired by material assignment.
Windows have fine frames, mullions, curtains and reflections not separately modeled. They remain neutral rather than being declared uniformly dark glass.
visual_review.palette_interpretation: #D4D4CA and #666966 are uncalibrated light ceramic and gray fascia color-family proxies. #AAA79F means neutral/unconfirmed model surfaces, not an assertion that all excluded real materials have that color.
visual_review.framing: Each 1200×1200 final image was inspected. Independent camera projection also confirms all original vertices are within all five orthographic frames.

exact_scope.piers: Angles 2..179 step 13 degrees; radial [40.45,44.95], tangent [-1.25,1.25], z [3,57]; only inner radial plane 40.45 and two tangent side planes +/-1.25. All vertices bounded.
exact_scope.canopy: Only y=1.5 front and x=+/-11.5 end vertical fascia, within x [-11.5,11.5], y [1.5,14.5], z [13.5,15.3] and outward normals. Top/underside excluded.
exact_scope.mapping: All native triangles independently reconciled to original canonical STL by exact oriented cyclic coordinate bijection. Actual 3MF vertices, triangle order/winding and all material corners match the original surface and recomputed map exactly. Actual delivered Blend independently reopened read-only, with all geometry and material indices verified.
